biotools.summary: signifinder is an R package within the Bioconductor project that allows users to collect and explore public transcriptional cancer signatures across various data types, including bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics. It provides a framework for assessing tumor characteristics and therapy responses using curated signature data.
